description: Implementation of LiveSignalPub interface for managing distributed publish-subscribe topics related to live signals, commands, events, and messages within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: LiveSignalPubImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the LiveSignalPub interface, managing distributed pubs for commands, events, and signals.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Initializes the LiveSignalPubImpl instance within an actor system context, setting up distributed pubs for commands, events, and messages.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Returns the distributed pub for commands.

methods.name: event
methods.description: Returns the distributed pub for events.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the distributed pub for signals/messages.

methods.name: getTopicExtractor
methods.description: Creates a PubSubTopicExtractor based on the streaming type, used to extract topics for pub/sub.
